visibleListingEvidence.visibleText: rendered page text with script, style and noscript bodies removed
visibleListingEvidence.rule: the phrase closest before the first displayed copy of a block's structured price labels that price

applicationState.role: reject only; embedded application state never establishes status or price
applicationState.rule: a whole-dollar structured price equal to an offer or estimate key value is rejected unless it also equals a list-price key value

regressionCases1_0_4.description: Added in 1.0.4 for the three Tier 2 production shadow failure modes; synthetic hosts and addresses only.

failureModes.pending-or-under-contract: Pending, contingent or under-contract evidence is never actively for sale.
failureModes.offer-price-as-list-price: Offer amounts are never the list price; an explicit list price wins.
failureModes.estimate-auction-or-off-market-as-for-sa: Estimates, assessed values, auction bids, rent and off-market pages never establish FOR_SALE.

regressionCases1_0_5.description: Added in 1.0.5 for the failure modes found comparing production answers with MLS data on 2026-10-26; synthetic hosts and addresses only.

failureModes.neighbour-page-as-exact-match: A page whose title or URL names another property never matches the requested address through a passing mention; nearby-home blocks on the requested property's own page do not make it another property.
failureModes.superseded-price-as-conflict: A fresh price stated more than a day before the newest fresh price is superseded, not a conflict.
failureModes.address-abbreviation-as-non-exact: USPS suffixes such as Bend/Bnd and Saint/St compare equal.
failureModes.pending-reason-as-non-exact: A home found pending or otherwise not active is reported as having no active signal, not as an address mismatch.

regressionCases1_0_6.description: Added in 1.0.6 for the CONFLICT answers found replaying production lookups on 2026-10-30; synthetic hosts and addresses only.

failureModes.repeated-status-as-ambiguous: One availability value repeated for one street address in a block (a listing offer repeated in its open-house event) is a single signal; several addresses or disagreeing values stay ambiguous.
failureModes.irrelevant-self-conflict-as-conflict: A self-contradicting page decides a conflict only when it is an exact and fresh match for the requested home.
